statement.p: (a) Find a formula for the perimeter of a square of side length s.

Which of the statements best explains the meaning of f(5)?
The side length of a square of perimeter P
The perimeter of a square of side length 5
The area of a square of side length 5
The side length of a square of area 5

Which of the statements best explains the meaning of f^{-1}(20)?
The side length of a square of area 20
The perimeter of a square of side length 20
The side length of a square of perimeter 20
The area of a square of side length 20
(d) Find a formula for the inverse function.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
(a) The perimeter of a square of side length s is P = f(s) = 4s.
(b) Thus, f(5) = 20, which is the perimeter of a square of side length 5.
(c) The inverse function s = f^{-1}(P) = P/4, so f^{-1}(20) = 5, which is the side length of a square of perimeter 20.
(d) The inverse function is obtained by solving P = f(s) = 4s for s = f^{-1}(P) = P/4.
